title: How a Radiator Heats Your Home in 60 Seconds 🔥🌀 #shorts
description:
Despite the name, a radiator mostly heats your room by convection. A boiler heats water, a pump circulates it through pipes, and the hot metal warms the air beside it, which rises and sets up a loop of warm air around the room. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#radiator #centralheating #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: Despite its name, a radiator heats your room mostly by *convection*, not radiation.

steps.label: Boiler
steps.text: It starts at the *boiler*, which heats water for the whole house.

steps.label: Pump
steps.text: A *pump* pushes that hot water through pipes to every radiator.

steps.label: Panel
steps.text: The water flows through the *metal panel*, and the metal gets hot.

steps.label: Convection
steps.text: Air touching the hot metal warms up, *rises*, and cool air flows in below. That loop heats the room.

steps.label: Return
steps.text: The cooled water flows *back* to the boiler to be heated again.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Heat, pump, *rise*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
